questions.question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom

It's a small world

options.text: Eventually, after a long period of time
A competition where the outcome is difficult to judge or predict
You frequently see the same people in different places

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"It's a small world"** means that you frequently encounter the same people or events in different places, suggesting that the world is more interconnected than it seems. (यह एक छोटा सा संसार है)

 
 
• **Example:** I met my old school friend in a different country;** it's a small world.**
 
 
 
• **Explanation:** This idiom is used to express surprise when you encounter someone you know in an unexpected place or situation. (स्पष्टीकरण: जब आप किसी अप्रत्याशित स्थान या स्थिति में किसी को जानते हैं तो यह मुहावरा आश्चर्य व्यक्त करने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है।)
 
 
• **Example:** Running into my cousin in a different city made me realize** it's a small world.**
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: Eventually, after a long period of time** (अंततः, लंबे समय के बाद)

 
 
• **Example:** Eventually, after a long period of time, they decided to get married.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: A competition where the outcome is difficult to judge or predict** (एक प्रतियोगिता जहाँ परिणाम का अनुमान लगाना कठिन है)
 
 
• **Example:** The match was a nail-biter, a competition where the outcome was difficult to judge or predict.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: An aggressive and bold confrontation** (एक आक्रामक और साहसी मुकाबला)
 
 
• **Example:** The debate quickly turned into an aggressive and bold confrontation.
